paite: “Huan a thillat, lemna thillat kithoihna ahih a, ganhon lak a alatleh, TOUPA ma ah gensiatbei alan ding ahi”.
heading: Lemna Thillat
english: “‘If his offering is a sacrifice of peace offerings, if he offers it from the herd, whether male or female, he shall offer it without defect before Yahweh.

paite: Athillat lutung ah akhut akoih dia, kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi bul ah agou ding. Aaron tapa siampute'n maitam kimvel ah sisan atheh ding uhi.
english: He shall lay his hand on the head of his offering, and kill it at the door of the Tent of Meeting. Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall sprinkle the blood around on the altar.

paite: Lemna thillat kithoihna, TOUPA a dia mei a thillat alan dia, asungkua, athau leh agilbom tengteng leh,
english: He shall offer of the sacrifice of peace offerings an offering made by fire to Yahweh. The fat that covers the innards, and all the fat that is on the innards,

paite: akal nihte leh atuamthau aphuk chin a omleh asin tuam lam, akalte toh kigawm in asuah ding ahi.
english: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away.

paite: Aaron tapate'n maitam ah mei a sing om tung a halmang thillat tung ah ahal ding uhi. Hiai TOUPA a dia gimlimtak, mei a thillat ahi.
english: Aaron’s sons shall burn it on the altar on the burnt offering, which is on the wood that is on the fire: it is an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

paite: “Lemna thillat kithoihna a TOUPA a dia athillat belamhon lak ate ahihleh, anu leng hita hen aw, apa leng hitaleh, gensiatbei ahih ding ahi”.
english: “‘If his offering for a sacrifice of peace offerings to Yahweh is from the flock, either male or female, he shall offer it without defect.

paite: Athillat a, belamnou alatleh TOUPA ma ah alan ding ahi.
english: If he offers a lamb for his offering, then he shall offer it before Yahweh;

paite: Athillat lutung ah akhut akoih ding a, kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi ah agou ding. Aaron tapate'n maitam kimvel ah asisan atheh ding uhi.
english: and he shall lay his hand on the head of his offering, and kill it before the Tent of Meeting. Aaron’s sons shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.

paite: Lemna thillat kithoihnate, TOUPA a dia mei a thillat alan ding ahi. Athaute leh ameibul thau mahmah atawn in, akawngguh tan in ala vek ding a; asungkua thaute, agilbom tengtengte,
english: He shall offer from the sacrifice of peace offerings an offering made by fire to Yahweh; its fat, the entire tail fat, he shall take away close to the backbone; and the fat that covers the entrails, and all the fat that is on the entrails,

paite: akal nihte leh aphuk chin a om, atuamthau leh asin tuam alap, akalte nangawn toh asuah ding ahi.
english: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away.

paite: siampu in huai maitam ah ahal dia; hiai TOUPA a dia mei a thillat nek ding ansiah ahi.
english: The priest shall burn it on the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire to Yahweh.

paite: “Athillat kel ahihleh ToUPA ma ah alan ding ahi,
english: “‘If his offering is a goat, then he shall offer it before Yahweh.

paite: Alutung ah akhut akoih ding a, kihoupihna biakbuk kong ah agou ding”. Aaron tapate'n maitam kimvel in sisan atheh ding uhi.
english: He shall lay his hand on its head, and kill it before the Tent of Meeting; and the sons of Aaron shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.

paite: Athillat pen alan dia, TOUPA a dia mei a thillat tak, asungkua thau leh agilbom tengteng leh,
english: He shall offer from it as his offering, an offering made by fire to Yahweh; the fat that covers the innards, and all the fat that is on the innards,

paite: akal nihte leh aphuk chin a om, atuamthau leh asin tuam lam, akalte toh nangawn in asuah ding ahi.
english: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away.

paite: Hiai siampu in maitam ah ahal ding ahi. Gimlim dia mei a thillat nek ding ansiah ahi a; athau tengteng TOUPA a tuam ahi.
english: The priest shall burn them on the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma; all the fat is Yahweh’s.

paite: Sathau hiam, sisan hiam na ne ding uh ahi kei, chih na suante uh a ding in abanban in na tenna phot uah tangtawn a dan thuseh ahi ding," achi hi.
english: “‘It shall be a perpetual statute throughout your generations in all your dwellings, that you shall eat neither fat nor blood.’”
